name: branding-blue-metal-supplier-signage-and-add-to-cart-modal
title: Light-box wall sign and mobile add-to-cart modal in blue and white
whatItIs: Two panels: a white light-box on grey concrete with a large blue '20' and the striped-monogram logo, and a phone screen with a white modal titled with a quantity stepper, price fields, cart summary and a blue Go-to-cart button.
whatItMeans: Straightforward and dependable; a physical sign and a clear modal show the same trustworthy brand.
techniques: Pair physical signage with a digital component.
Use a big blue numeral as an anniversary graphic.
Design the modal with grouped inputs and one blue action.
Place the sign on raw concrete.

vocabulary.definition: An illuminated box sign mounted to a wall.
A large number marking years in business.
A panel over a dimmed screen for a task.
Applications in both physical and digital forms.
